title: Does Feature Absorption Concentrate on Safety-Relevant Concepts?

original_idea.body: Probe open SAE latents for safety-adjacent concepts for absorption (recall against in-concept examples) and compare absorption rates for safety vs neutral concepts.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: if absorption concentrates on safety features, SAE monitors silently fail on the cases that matter (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open SAEs + labeled latents + curated recall; guided, concept curation overhead (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but curating reliable safety latents adds a dependency (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open SAEs/dashboards, externally runnable interpretability-to-safety audit (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Whether absorption concentrates on safety concepts described as untested; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Safety-concept concentration of absorption appears mostly novel.
